comments: Migrants steal swans from parks to eat. I have seen pictures, I have seen videos. The park doesn't fucking matter. The time period doesn't fucking matter.  It's bad. Deport. Is there a reason it's fine to kill a mallard when you're a Brit at a shoot, but not when you're from eastern Europe?
There's a big difference between shooting ducks in their natural habitat and stealing them from parks where people are there to enjoy them.
Also, it's just straight up illegal for anyone (other than Royals) to kill and eat swans.
